name: gcri-project
description: GRAICE monorepo — run frontend + backend together locally

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: node scripts/prepare-dev.mjs && npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.postinstall:all: echo Dependencies installed for root, backend, and frontend.
